main_body: green grass ground terrain patch (labelled sky)
evidence: This is a flat terrain ground patch (repeating 16x16 grass tiles), for which a top-down surface view with 0 front face rows is appropriate for kind=terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate is a single 16x16 grass tile stamped identically 12 times in a 4x3 grid. It uses only 4 green shades with large uniform mid-green flat fills (e.g. 5x8 blocks) and a blocky 2x6 vertical light-green bar in each tile that creates obvious repetitive seams, whereas the Beodeul reference uses varied tiles, subtler dithered base variation, and richer multi-tone grass/flower speckles.
